note: Without a date a study cannot appear in the readouts-due view.

note: The rest are mostly healthy-volunteer Phase 1 studies. Area comes from the condition text, then MeSH, then the molecule (see C15).

Every date the registry gives can be read
note: Dates come as a day, a month or a year; a month is stored as the first of the month and flagged.

name: Start is not after primary completion when both are ACTUAL
note: Kept and flagged, left out of timing measures if any appear.

name: Status and phase are values the model knows
Pipeline enrollment is between 0 and 100,000
note: 98 studies outside the pipeline exceed 100,000: observational database studies (one covers 188 million people). They are real, not errors, and are not drug-development studies.

name: One row per study
note: The same study is found by several searches (Merck and MSD); it is kept once.

name: One row per study and country
Studies loaded per search equal the total the API announced
note: 37,564 study rows over 44 searches; API data as of 2026-10-14T09:00:05 (unchanged at the end of the download).

name: Every distinct study fetched is in scope or quarantined with a reason
note: Nothing is dropped silently.

name: MSD study count equals a fresh count from the API
result: 2,189 in the warehouse vs 2,189 from the API (data date 2026-10-14)
rule: equal on the same data date
note: Studies whose lead name contains 'Merck Sharp & Dohme', including ArQule's.

name: Active pipeline studies assigned a therapeutic area
note: Text first, then MeSH, then the molecule's usual area. What no step can place stays Unclassified, never spread across other areas.

name: Active pipeline studies with a molecule key
note: Placebo, saline, standard of care and similar comparators are not counted as molecules.

name: Merck products in Rx Market Pulse with at least one MSD study
note: All 14 families match by molecule name, MK development code or brand name.

name: Condition text and registry MeSH terms agree on the area
note: The registry's MeSH matching is automatic: a lung-cancer study that mentions PD-L1 is also tagged with a Parkinson disease term. Text wins, so those disagreements do not change the area.

name: Stopped pipeline studies whose reason fits a theme
note: The reason is free text and often reads 'see detailed description'. It is mapped by rules, so treat the themes as indicative.

name: No sponsor name that mentions a company falls through the rules
note: The search is full-text, so names such as 'University of Bristol' come back for 'Bristol'. Each is set aside by an explicit rule; a name that mentions a company and matches no rule is a failure.

name: Merck KGaA is never counted as MSD
result: 0 in the MSD group; 348 Merck KGaA studies set aside
note: Same name, different company: Merck KGaA of Darmstadt owns the name outside the US and Canada.

name: Studies MSD gains from the roll-up of acquired companies
note: Cubist, Acceleron, Verona, Prometheus, ArQule and others, under their current owner as of October 2026. Divested or spun-off units (Organon, Alcon, Sandoz) are excluded, not reassigned.

name: Every country spelling maps to an ISO code
note: Spellings such as 'Turkey (Türkiye)' and 'Korea, Republic of' are mapped in data/ref/countries.csv.

name: Age of the data snapshot at build time
note: The snapshot is frozen on purpose so every number on the site and the CV agree.
